record_type: Retained summary of completed independent synthetic comparisons; comparisons were not rerun to create this artifact.

methodology.baseline: Exact prior credential_assignment bytes expression independently compiled from source.
methodology.candidate: Only the greedy ASCII identifier-prefix branch receives (?<![a-z0-9_-]) after the optional opening quote. Other alternatives and captures remain unchanged.

crafted_payloads.construction: Cartesian product:16 prefix boundaries x18 key variants x3 key quote choices x4 assignment separators x6 synthetic values.

randomized_payloads.construction: One to five adjacent synthetic fragments with random identifier keys, boundary bytes, assignment separators, quote/triple-quote/backtick variants and synthetic values.

reference_exemptions.construction: 4 encoding/header variants x18 keys x6 synthetic values x4 quote variants. Swap old/new compiled expression in an isolated process, clear _python_reference_spans cache, compare each match span and credential_assignment_is_reference result for synthetic.py.

coverage: UTF-8, BOM, non-ASCII, invalid-byte and NUL boundaries
bare names and allowed attribute-reference shapes versus string literals

reasoning: For a full-payload search, the earliest successful greedy-prefix branch already starts at the left edge of its maximal ASCII identifier run. Later starts within the same run cannot add a first match. A prior successful match consumes every following identifier-class value byte or ends with a consumed quote, so sequential finditer cannot restart inside an unconsumed identifier run. Unanchored oanda-token, secret and password alternatives retain their existing suffix detections.
limitation: No equivalence is claimed for re.search or finditer with an explicit pos inside an identifier run. Such calls can differ. Both scanner finditer callers use the complete payload with no explicit pos. Generated comparisons are evidence, not an exhaustive proof for all possible byte strings.
test_source_review: Read the final targeted test source bound above: it exercises differential spans, token references, synthetic alert preservation, bounded encoded-payload performance and archiveability without adding exemptions. Its pytest counts belong to separate implementation/regression receipts and are not these generated comparison counts.
